[SWS_CM_00073] Reception of Time-Synchronous Control Format messages
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If an
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message is received and the attribute
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.acfMaxTransitTime
is defined, then the
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message presentation time shall be checked:
• if the current time of the
GlobalTimeDomain
referenced by
IEEE1722TpConnection.globalTimeDomain
is greater than the pre-
sentation time of the received
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message (the message
